TFG Marina Hotel is a serviced hotel apartment development in the heart of Dubai Marina, developed by The First Group and operated by Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, one of the world’s largest hotel management companies. The building is close to the Marina waterfront, the beach, the metro and the tram, with restaurants, shops and daily conveniences nearby.
